Trend or Range? Stop Using the Same Playbook Everywhere

Trending markets often create directional swings, while ranging markets rotate between boundaries. The same entry idea can behave very differently in those two environments. Start by asking what the market is doing before choosing your framework. Context first, setup second. Do not force a trend simply because you want one.

TRADING IS NOT FOR THOSE WHO DON'T HAVE PATIENCE.  LEARN | TRADE | EARN
